name: Korad
description: Korad was a planet in Elrood sector on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It was covered with starship and vehicle wrecks and was, in essence, a massive salvage yard operated during the Old Republic era by a corporation called Renew which eventually went bankrupt. During the Rebellion era many refugees and scavengers inhabited the planet. It was the homeworld of Slythor, a Squib crime lord.
